summary: This RFC specifies a Telnet option for exchanging terminal type information. It supersedes RFC 884, with the one change that the TERMINAL-TYPE IS sub-negotiation is sent only in answer to a SEND request. It was replaced by RFC 1091.

eli5.summary: When you connect, your computer can say what kind of screen it has when asked. This version only answers after being asked.

questions: how does telnet negotiate terminal type
